title: devbin test bats ignores its paths and flags: the handler runs the whole suite, and config's bats option is dead
body:
## What happens

`bin/devbin test bats <paths>` and `bin/devbin test bats --filter <re>` run the WHOLE suite. The paths and flags are dropped without a word.

`bin/.devbin/cmd/test`, devbin's own test handler, runs:

    run_gate --label "tests (bats)" --suffix bats --grammar shell ... -- bats tests/unit

with no `"$@"` after `bats`. The handler owns the `bats` option (`run_option` step 1, `lib/resolve`, gives it to a project handler before config `run:` is read), so config's `commands.test.options.bats` (`run: bats tests/unit`, `grammar: bats`, `log: BATS`) is never reached either. That block is dead.

## Where the docs promise otherwise

- `bin/.devbin/help/test.d/bats.md`: "With no paths it runs everything under `tests/unit/`; with paths it runs exactly those", and "Flags devbin does not recognise pass straight through to bats, which is what makes `--filter` and friends work".
- `bin/.devbin/help/test.md`: `devbin test [bats|all] [paths...]`, and the seal named `tmp/test/<stamp>.BATS.out`. It is `.bats.out`: the handler's `--suffix bats` wins, and config's `log: BATS` is never read.

## How it was found, and what is NOT measured

vc's docs-against-code sweep, 2026-09-18 (item 18 of the framework-half list sent to cc; hv ruled it an issue on 2026-09-19). **Read from the code, not driven**: driving it runs the full suite, which is a tree lock. The fix's first arm should drive it, red: a `test bats tests/unit/<one file>.bats` that must run that file's count and no more.

## Why it matters

Every targeted run in this project's working practice (one file, its own TMPDIR) goes through `bats` directly, because the documented route does not work. That is what the help sends people to, and it silently costs them a full suite. Devbin's own suite is the one D12 uses to prove the dispatcher, so the documented form not working is devbin's own surface being wrong about itself.

## Shape of a fix (not prescribed)

Forward the handler's remaining arguments to bats, defaulting to `tests/unit` when none are given, and either delete the dead config block or make the handler read it -- one of the two, not both (Highlander). The seal suffix and the help text follow from whichever wins.

## Fix

`196e06a` (vc), with dc's N1 at `ff42a93`; reviewed by dc, passed. Shipped in devbin 0.1.2. The handler forwards its paths and flags to bats and runs `tests/unit` only when it is given no path; `--purge`, `--purge-only` and `--allow-empty` are split out for the gate through `gate_split_args`, as at every other gate. A flag's value is told from a path by a list of the bats flags that take one, and a test holds that list to the installed bats's own `--help` (dc's N1: `--negative-filter` was missing, and the drift arm names it when dropped). The dead `run:`, `grammar:` and `log:` under `commands.test.options.bats` are deleted, the handler being the one reader (the Highlander half of the shape above), and `help/test.md` names the seal the handler makes, `.bats.out`. Seven arms in `tests/unit/testhandler.bats`, all red first.
